unsafe_justifications.justification: No unsafe code. Proof binding and ownership checks delegate to the frozen root validate_body implementation. Encoding writes once into the root bounded BodySink; the validated payload owner is moved unchanged into the outgoing message.

The test validator matches complete literal JSON objects against two registered schemas with the same required string field. Checked payload and decoded lengths, exact UTF-8 spans, and scalar counts describe the actual immutable buffers and sole string slot. Fault tests mutate already proven output using safe operations so the root rejects mismatched evidence; they do not issue invalid proofs.

test_vectors.execution: Not executed, as explicitly required. No cargo, rustc, rustfmt, git commit, build command, or check command was run.
coverage: Exactly one encoding and validation call; exact fingerprint; retained owner identity, whitespace, UTF-8, escapes, raw spans, and decoded spans.
Request and response builders generate one application/json Content-Type and one canonical decimal Content-Length; preserve supplied header values, order, unknown duplicates, and identity encoding.

Content-Length accepts ASCII OWS and leading zeroes only after exact byte-length verification. Empty, signed, comma-list, embedded-whitespace, fractional, hexadecimal, non-ASCII, overflowing, shorter, and longer values fail with the specified errors.
Duplicate Content-Length, Content-Type, and Content-Encoding are rejected even with identical values. Transfer-Encoding and nonidentity content codings are rejected.

Valid application/json and application/*+json media types and UTF-8 charset parameters are preserved. Invalid subtypes, quotes, charset values, unknown parameters, and duplicate parameters are rejected.

All six supported methods and valid absolute HTTP(S) targets are preserved. HEAD, relative targets, malformed schemes, authorities, ports, IPv6, percent escapes, userinfo, fragments, controls, and non-ASCII hosts fail before encoding.
Every status from 0 through 600 plus u16::MAX is classified. Only 200 through 299 excluding 204 and 205 produce typed success bodies; invalid statuses cause no encoding or validation.
All three exports preflight invalid limits. Effective body caps test exact and one-byte-over boundaries for both transport and syntax limits; remaining syntax policy is forwarded unchanged.
Final header count and storage limits include generated fields, UTF-8 bytes, separators, and final CRLF. Oversized padded supplied lengths can normalize into an exactly fitting final header set.
Unicode byte lengths differ from character counts; a 17-byte Unicode body succeeds at 17 and fails at 16, and a supplied character-count Content-Length is rejected.
Encoder and validator errors retain source, offset, schema ID, field ID, and detail through every export; partial encoded bodies are discarded.
Encoder success does not bypass validation of empty bytes, wrong shapes, nonfinite literals, trailing content, or invalid UTF-8.
All exports reject wrong fingerprints, substituted payload bytes, mismatched payload lengths, and mismatched decoded lengths. Decoded arena limits test zero, one, and two bytes.
Decimal formatting tests zero, digit transitions, u32::MAX, u64 overflow, addressable u64::MAX, and payload lengths above the ABI range when representable.
BodySink reservation and write failures retain the existing prefix; exact-capacity writes and empty writes succeed.
